status: Recovered serialization components only. Original ARM control flow is compared under an explicitly controlled memory-file/callback host.
reference: Unmodified original ARM/Thumb functions with real register/stack calling conventions; SDK read/write and callback boundaries bind controlled memory-file services. Caller-saved registers/flags are randomized across those boundaries.
checked: Declared result words, original SP/callee-saved registers, every arena/canary/context byte, ordered host/callback traces, file content hashes and cursor positions.
hostScope: Read/write ABI is recovered from original call sites. Differential tests bind a controlled memory-file host to ARM and Wasm; they do not independently prove all Marmalade SDK host behavior. The bridge import dispatches an original callback token; callback bodies are not recovered here.
limits: Nonnegative practical counts and bit widths, valid buffers/strides/context. Nonzero division denominator and callback period. Boolean reads need complete source bytes; string reads require a reachable NUL. No complete resource parser, asynchronous streaming, native file-open layer or save persistence.
